knownLimitations: The qualification evidence was synthetic and explicitly labeled. An attestor signature proves wallet control, not invoice issuer identity, invoice origin, or document truth. Payable values are determinations only; this contract does not escrow or transfer funds. Cases are append-only with no deletion or pruning interface.
name: InvoiceBasis
short: Determine invoice eligibility from frozen terms and evidence, then derive a bounded payable basis with deterministic integer arithmetic.
problem: Invoice eligibility can be semantically ambiguous while payable arithmetic, rates and rounding must remain fixed and reproducible.
solution: InvoiceBasis creates a consent-bound invoice case with immutable eligibility terms, bounded gross minor units and a fixed rational rate. A distinct designated attestor wallet signs the evidence digest. GenLayer validators independently assess invoice class, exclusions and evidence sufficiency; the contract calculates the provisional payable basis using integer floor division and never transfers funds. Challenges and second-round deliberation precede finalization.
outcomes: Leader and validators independently classify the exact eligibility vector inside gl.vm.run_nondet_unsafe. The strict boolean vector is validated; disagreement aborts adjudication. Contract code derives ELIGIBLE, INELIGIBLE or REVIEW_REQUIRED and computes the provisional payable amount using bounded integers and deterministic floor division.
productionQualification: Standalone deployed V4 contract source and ABI verified; complete historic lifecycle finalized with recorded inconclusive/review outcome; Portal dossier prepared, not submitted.
